## Make functions that calculate summary statistics and apply them to a variable to show that they work
```{r}
# Import the Height and Weight dataset
heightweight <- read.table("C:\\Users\\HP\\Desktop\\Exercises\\height_weight_data.txt", header = TRUE)

# Display the first six rows
head(heightweight)

# Check the structure of the dataset
str(heightweight)


# Creating a function that calculates summary statistics
summarystatistics <- function(x) {

  # Count the number of observations
  n <- length(x)

  # Calculate the mean
  meanvalue <- sum(x) / n

  # Sort the values in ascending order
  sortednumbers <- sort(x)

  # Calculate the median
  if (n %% 2 == 0) {
    medianvalue <- (sortednumbers[n/2] + sortednumbers[n/2 + 1]) / 2
  } else {
    medianvalue <- sortednumbers[(n + 1)/2]
  }

  # Calculate the minimum value
  minimumvalue <- min(x)

  # Calculate the maximum value
  maximumvalue <- max(x)

  # Calculate the sample variance
  variancevalue <- sum((x - meanvalue)^2) / (n - 1)

  # Calculate the standard deviation
  sdvalue <- sqrt(variancevalue)

  # Combine all calculated function into a list to be able to create get summary statistics
  results <- list(
    Count = n,
    Mean = meanvalue,
    Median = medianvalue,
    Minimum = minimumvalue,
    Maximum = maximumvalue,
    Variance = variancevalue,
    StandardDeviation = sdvalue
  )

  # Return the calculated results
  return(results)
}


# Apply the function to either Height or weight

# Calculate summary statistics for Height
heightresults <- summarystatistics(heightweight$Height)

# Display Height results
print("Summary Statistics for Height")
print(heightresults)

# Calculate summary statistics for Weight
weightresults <- summarystatistics(heightweight$Weight)

# Display Weight results
print("Summary Statistics for Weight")
print(weightresults)

```

## Make a function to calculate a two-sample t test, then apply it to your data.

```{r}
# Exam scores for students in Class A
class_A <- c(65, 70, 75, 80, 85)

# Exam scores for students in Class B
class_B <- c(55, 60, 65, 70, 75)
# Function to perform a two-sample t-test
two_sample_ttest <- function(x, y) {

  # Compare the means of the two groups
  result <- t.test(x, y)

  # Return the test result
  return(result)
}
# Apply the function to Class A and Class B
test_result <- two_sample_ttest(class_A, class_B)

# Display the results
print(test_result)
```
